params.message:
A copy of a bought-over sheet is not a second purchase

Copying a sheet took seller_vehicle_id and seller_id along, so a copy of a
car bought from a colleague counted as a buy-over without its transaction
and set off stocklist:check-transactions. Copying now leaves both out; the
purchase stays on the parent. stocklist:detach-copied-purchases clears them
on the copies that already inherited them (dry run by default).
